correctness.rationale: Reconstructed ordinary path-complement adjacency, fort definition, absence of size-one/two forts via lack of exterior twins, automatic fort property for sets of size >=4, exact 101 criterion for three-sets, and four-set sorted-gap classification. Counting 101-avoiding triples gives the rank-3 coefficient; every four-set is a fort and exactly the 2/y/2-gap four-sets are minimal. A forcing process from any open-gap triple reduces to at most two whites; the latter are forceable. The complete polynomial follows. Verified 32,752 subsets for 4<=n<=14 with standalone source packaged here. No extrapolation of finite data is used for general n.

value.rationale: The entire inclusion-minimal fort hypergraph of a natural dense infinite graph family is obtained, including its first essential rank-four constraints at n=6. The rank-four class is not captured by the scalar zero forcing number or generic high-degree polynomial coefficients; its explicit shape gives a full minimal fort-cover formulation, and yields a closed cardinality distribution and count of minimum forcing configurations. The claim is a motivated complete classification of structural blockers, not an arbitrary parameter slice or known-table recomputation.
